text.p: Following are the main stories in Slovenia's Monday morning newspapers:
- The President of Italy Oscar Luigi Scalfaro will visit Slovenia on Monday.
- Slovenian Prime Minister Janez Drnovsek and Foreign Minister Zoran Thaler will participate at the NATO summit in Madrid on Tuesday.
- Drnovsek is the political personality of the month, an opinion poll showed.

- According to an opinion poll, 25 percent of Slovenians would vote for the centre-left Liberal Democrats, 13 percent for the centre-right Social Democrats and 11 percent for the conservative People's Party if elections were held this week.
- The mayor of Ljubljana Dimitrij Rupel and the city council have not yet agreed on the 1997 city budget.
- Hotels at the Slovenian coast were completely full over the weekend.
- Slovenian tennis players Katarina Srebotnik and Maja Matevzic came second in the women's youth double competition in Wimbledon.
- About half the population of Slovenia attended a variety of cultural events to mark the European Month of Culture that ended in Ljubljana on Friday.
